subject: Upcoming Company Event: Annual Team Building Day
body: Dear Team, We are excited to announce our upcoming Annual Team Building Day on Friday, 15th October. This year's event will be held at the local adventure park and will include team-building activities, games, and a barbecue lunch. Please RSVP by Monday, 11th October, so we can finalize the headcount. We look forward to a day of fun and bonding with our amazing team! Best regards, [Your Name]
